author: KEXP
description:
Sabela Maneiro, Aida Tarrío and Olaia Maneiro come together under the musical project @tanxugueiras. Infusing their sound with Galician tradition and contemporary style, they share an electric performance of "As que tiñan que estar" and more Live on KEXP in Bilbao.

Watch the full session and interview on our YouTube channel.
title: Tanxugueiras performs "As que tiñan que estar" & more Live on KEXP in Bilbao
